According to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), the punishment for five sins is awarded in five ways namely (1) A nation not honouring its word, is subdued by the enemy. (2) People who take decisions according to laws other than Allah's are impoverished either in the form of scarcity or inflation, or a disease (3) A nation plagued with adultery suffers epidemics. (4) The defaulters of Zakāt are deprived of rainfall altogether, or it pours down at odd times and (5) A nation defrauding in measure is struck by famine. All these forms can be seen in today's world as well as in our own country. May Allah grant us the power to get rid of these evils!

Don't the offenders know that they have to answer before Allah on the Day of Reckoning, when the entire mankind will be present for accountability? Remember that the Registers of Conduct of evildoers are kept in Sijjān and so, according to Hadīth, are their Arwāḥ, a place at the lowest ebb of the earth. O' Reader! Have you any idea of the Sijjān? It is a gigantic Record Office formally organized which will prove devastating for the deniers of the Day of Judgement, denied only by the transgressors and the evildoers. And when Allah's verses are recited to them they dismiss these as fables of the past. In fact, it is due to their evil conduct that their hearts have become rusty, and are mal-functioning.

Divine Cognition and Human Qalb

Every human being is endowed with natural instinct to seek Allah. That is why no nation in history ever remained unmindful of religion. Rather every nation practised some rituals concocted in the name of religion. To get to the Truth in this field an enlightened Qalb is imperative. When it becomes rusty due to sinning, it loses the inherent capacity to accept the Truth. This is explained by a saying of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) that even when the believer commits a sin, a black spot appears on his heart, which can, however, be cleansed by penitence. But if he persists, this spot enlarges until the entire heart is darkened, driving him astray. This may be observed in our society today.

To cleanse the hearts Zikr-e-Qalbi is imperative, whereby a sinner is blessed with penitence and a pious with higher levels of Divine Cognition. So on that Day the inborn instinct to behold Allah will be enlivened in the believers, while the infidels will be debarred. This proves that every human being is given a natural desire to behold Allah. Had it not been so the infidels would not have felt sad when debarred. They will be pushed into Hell and told that this indeed was the Day they had denied in their lifetime.

Now the Registers of Conduct of the pious are kept in the 'Illiyyān, a magnificent Record Office guarded by the angels enjoying Allah's nearness. According to Hadith, it is located between the seventh heaven and the 'Arsh where the Arvāḥ of the righteous are stationed. Remember that a Rūḥ whether in Sijjān or 'Illiyyān, maintains a nexus with each and every particle of its physical body. On that Day, the righteous will be in delightful moods enjoying the view reclining on couches, which will reflect from their faces. They will be offered exquisite drinks sealed especially for them with pure musk. The seekers must, therefore, dedicate all their efforts in pursuit of these bounties. And a special spring called Tasnān will be at the disposal of His bondsmen to drink from.

A cause for the misfortune of the evil doers was their dension of the pious. Whenever they would pass by them they would exchange meaningful looks and gestures. And during their indoor meetings, they would focus on making fun of the noble believers. Outside when they see the believers they would comment that these were the foolish people who had strayed.

The Aulia' must not be Ridiculed

The righteous scholars assert that refuting the Aulia' deprives a person of their Barakah and it must be avoided. But to ridicule them is a crime which divests a person of his capacity to repent and it should never be done. Afterall the evil doers have not been entrusted with the vigilance of the nobles. The denders will see on the Day of Reckoning how Allah's bondmen are honourably seated on couches, smiling on the foolishness of the offenders and enquiring whether they had been thoroughly requited.

Sūrah al Inshiqāq (THE SUNDERING) Revealed at Makkah, it has only one Section with twenty five Āyāt.

When the sky splits asunder in compliance with the Command of its Rabb, and the earth expands to cast forth all that lies buried in it, human beings, animals or minerals, in obedience to its Rabb as that is what befits both the most.

Types of Commands

There are two types of Commands. Firstly those relating to the genesis enforced upon each and every atom. The human beings, jim, earth, the heavens, and all that lies therein are bound to obey these Commands. For instance, a person has no say in matters pertaining to his birth, physical features, physique or wisdom. Secondly are the Commands of Shari'ah, whereby a person is informed of the requital of each action, but enjoys the freedom to act. This is for the sentient creation. So O'mankind! You have to endure through the turmoil of life to eventually stand before your Rabb, where all your actions will be right in front of you.

Turmoil is a Part of Life

The path of life is tainted with hardships. From cradle to grave, it is not only the pious who face problems, but also the evil doers who experience even worse, poor and the affluent alike. And the problems faced by the Governments are far greater than by the governed. So wisdom demands that if one has to bear hardships, why not in the path of piety, for sin is more cumbersome and ultimately humiliating.

On the Day of Judgement whoever is handed down the Register of Conduct in his right hand will avail an easy Reckoning, which means that Allah will not question him on any aspect of conduct. And he will return to his family delighted, as the pious will remain together. And whoever is handed the Register of Conduct from behind the back; that is, in his left hand; (the left hand will be twisted and pushed through the back to emerge in front to receive it) will long for death, which will not be there. And he will be hurled into the blazing Hell, for he lived amongst his kindred a life of merriment, assuming that he would never face Reckoning.

By the evening twilight dissipating redness, by the night that follows and enshrouds everything and by the full moon, when it shines all over, similar is the sequence of life. Mankind is gradually heading towards their end in a constant journey seen by the sun, just as man sees it rise and set. Then why don't people embrace Islam in the presence of both logical and recorded evidences? And when Qurān is recited why don't they prostrate, and obey Allah sincerely. The infidels deny and only Allah Knows what they harbour in their spiteful minds. They must know that a painful doom awaits them. And the believers shall enjoy never ending rewards.

(THE BIG STARS) Revealed at Makkah, it has only one Section and twenty two Āyāt.

By the heaven which has citadels for the guards! According to many reports Burūj (singular Burj ) alludes to the citadels or fortresses of the angels that guard the heaven. Astronomers have hypothetically divided the heaven into twelve parts, naming each as Burj. They assert that stars exist within the Burj and the planets also travel through them. They have named these constellations after the shape they take, for instance, Aries, Taurus, Gemini etc. However, all this is utterly absurd in the light of Islam. By the promised Day of Judgement and by every individual who testifies to the Truth, and by each Truth which is testified, all these affairs, that is, the heaven, the Day of Judgement, every truthful witness and every Truth bears witness to the destruction of those who had burnt the believers alive in trenches. They had remorselessly ignited the fuel stacked therein and had pushed the believers in it, group after group, watching them as they burnt. Episode of People of the Trench Reports reveal many incidents of the persecution of Muslims. But this particular incident refers to the one suffered by the believers at the hands of the King of Yemen, Yūsuf Zunwas bin Sharjeel. When his official sooth-sayer grew old, he was provided a young intelligent lad as student to transfer his skills to him. This boy, however, met a Wali, became a Muslim and learnt Allah's Zikr from him. He would go to the old sooth-sayer but stealthily take some time out to visit the Wali. Allah blessed him with Karamah to heal the ailing. Eventually the news reached the King, and he ordered the execution of the Wali. However, all his plans to kill the boy failed. One day the boy himself told the King how to kill him. He counselled the King to assemble all his subjects, tie him down and take an arrow from the boy's personal quiver and shoot at his temple, after reciting Bismillah (in the Name of Allah) on it. Propagation The King did as told and the boy fell martyr. But the masses witnessing the whole episode accepted the true faith and declared: "We believe in the Rabb of this boy", who succeeded in propagating the true faith publicly. The King was infuriated and ordered that a trench be dug at the mouth of every alley, filled up with fuel and ignited. And that only those who renounce Islam be spared, and the rest be pushed into the flames. But nobody chose apostasy over martyrdom. It is reported that before they fell into the inferno, their Arwāh were taken away by Allah to spare them the consequent pain. But the inferno got out of control and reduced everyone to ashes. The King fled to take refuge in the river, but perished and was ushered into the Hell. The State of a Martyr in the Grave The boy mentioned in this incident was Abdullah bin Tāmir. It is reported by Mohammad bin Abdullah bin Abu Bakr Şiddīq (Radi Allah-o Anhu) that during Hadhrat 'Umar (Radi Allah-o Anhu) caliphate, in an excavation, the body of the said boy was discovered sitting up with his hand on his temple. When his hand was pulled away, blood oozed out of the wound. Aini when it was released, it went back on his temple. He was also wearing a ring whereon was inscribed Rabbi Allah (Allah is my Rabb). The Governor of Yemen wrote to Hadhrat 'Umar 22(v) about the whole affair, who advised him to re-bury the boy as he was. The Muslims burnt alive had committed no crime. They had only believed in the Rabb, the Absolute and Worthy of all Praise, Who enjoys Sovereignty over the universe and is thoroughly Aware of everything. All those who perpetrate violence against the believing men and women will be condemned to Hell to suffer a doom of burning, unless they repent. The Divine Mercy Hadhrat Hassan Baṣri 22(a) asserts that Allah's Mercy is unlimited, for He does not close down the door of repentance even unto the persecutors of His Aulia' and the evil doers. Instead He invites them to repentance.

Sure Win

Certainly, the Jannah wherein rivers flow awaits the believers. To win it is indeed a grand achievement. In other words, a believer is successful both as a victor as well as a martyr, as the latter ushers him to his final destination. Surely Allah's Grip is very firm. He gives existence and enforces extinction. It is He Who created for the very first time and will do it once again. He is extremely Forgiving and Loving, is the Monarch of the magnificent 'Arsh and does whatever pleases Him. O' reader! Have you not heard of the legions of the Pharaoh and the Thamūd, how they were seized by Allah's Grip on denial? Similarly all those who deny are not at all beyond His Grip. And the Qurān they deny is indeed Glorious. It is also inscribed on the Guarded Table, precluding the possibility of any alteration whatsoever.

(THE NIGHT COMER) Revealed at Makkah, it has seventeen Āyāt and only one Section.

By the heaven and the star that shines when it is dark! In other words, just as the stars are always present in the heaven but shine only when the day comes to an end, so is the system of human actions. Every action is held safely until the darkness of death takes over allowing these actions to make an appearance. Certainly upon all souls are appointed Guardian Angels who record their conduct. According to Hadith, the Guardian Angels are appointed over every person to provide protection against all hazards, save that ordained by Allah. The denier of quickening may recollect how he had been created the first time into a physical body, from a gushing fluid, that is, the sperm secreted inside a human body. The loins and breast bones may allude to the entire body.

In other words, what an extensive process it is, whereby He collects each and every atom destined for a person around the globe then transforms these into different items to reach the body as food. And from within the body is secreted the sperm which He moulds into human form and adorns it with innumerable qualities. For sure, He is Potent over quickening it. These deniers will also know on the Day of Gathering when the hidden secrets of everyone will also be unveiled, and their Registers of Conduct brought forth. They will neither have any power, nor will anyone else be able to help them.

The frequent downpour from the heaven that cleaves the soil and lets the herbage sprout forth is also a witness to the fact that Allah, not only once, but can bring to life as many times as He wishes. Indeed this is a clear-cut statement, by no means a joke. Though the infidels work out strategies for themselves, yet the Divine Plan takes everyone to his logical sequel. They do, however, have a moment of respite to determine their course of action.

(THE MOST HIGH) Revealed at Makkah, it has nineteen Āyāt and only one Section.

Praise the exalted Name of your Rabb, Who created everything from non existence. (When this Āyah was revealed the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) prescribed its recitation in Sajdah). He then fashioned every being into the most appropriate form and disposition. And the purpose for which He created a thing, He gave it the capacity to accomplish that purpose as well as an inclination towards it.

Nature's Gift

This can be witnessed in the entire Universal System that everything has been given a form, an understanding and the capacity to perform the function it is created for, together with a natural tendency towards its goal. The sun, the moon, the stars, the clouds, the air, the inert objects, the botanical world, all perform the task assigned to them as scheduled. Similarly, the animals have been given a natural instinct for the functions they must perform; for instance, the birds fly, the aquatic animals swim, while life in the jungle portrays a ceaseless effort for survival. Science

Likewise, He endowed human beings the capability to discover the methods how to utilize things on earth and whosever acquires this skill is called a scientist. Remember that science does not create a new substance, it only puts together things already created. In the same way, the desire to seek Allah, and the capacity to attain His nearness has been instilled into human nature and the means of guidance are also provided: Glorified be Allah, the Best of Creators. It is by His Omnipotence that the green fodder grows that later turns into stubble. All life on the earth is destined to meet its sequel sooner or later.

O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam)! We will teach you the Qurān in a manner that you will never forget. So you need not worry that you may forget after Jibril (Alaihi as-Salam) leaves.

Law of Causes

In this world of causes, the Angel's visit is a cause, though Allah could commit the Qurān to his memory. However, forgetting the Āyāt abrogated by Him is a separate issue as He desired it that way. According to the scholars, one form of this abrogation was that the abrogated Āyah would be erased from his memory as well as of his Companions (Radi Allah-o Anhum), for He indeed is Aware of overt and the covert

Shari'ah becoming Second Nature

Allah promises that He will make the way of life easy, that is, He will make Shari’ah a second nature to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam). This is his peculiarity that practising Dīn became a part of his very nature. This blessing is also endowed to a Wali commensurate to his adherence to him. So the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) may continue to admonish people where it is likely to benefit them.

Advice and Ẓikr Allah

And it also alludes to practising Allah's Ẓikr, so that Shari'ah becomes second nature to a believer. Anyone renouncing both, can only be the one destined as fuel for Hell, wherein is neither life, nor death. And anyone who cleanses himself of the impurities in belief and practice, through Allah's Ẓikr is sure to succeed.

Zikr Allah

Regular Ẓikr ushers in the capacity to worship as well as adds devotion and sincerity to worship. Thus every aspect of practical life, be it business, peace or war, domestic or national, transforms into worship. Otherwise those who remain deprived of Allah's Ẓikr are bewitched by the love of this world and in the process lose the Ākhirah. All pleasures of the temporal life are transitory, while Ākhirah is far more superior and permanent. Allah's Ẓikr gives the capacity to obey, which in turn, facilitates pursuit of the Ākhirah. This reality had been expounded in the Divine Scrolls and Books whether revealed to Prophets Ibrāhim or Mūsa (Alaihi as-Salam).

(THE ENVELOPING) Revealed at Makkah, it has twenty six Āyāt and only one Section.

Shall We recount to you O’ Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) the proceedings of the Qayamah which will enshroud everything! Many faces will be covered with humiliation, of those who had toiled and worked overtime in pursuit of the world. They will reach the Field of Gathering tired and weary, only to be condemned into the blazing inferno of the Hell. They will be served boiling water and tormenting food which will neither satiate their hunger nor nourish their selves. In other words, the very food offered will also be a form of chastisement for them.

Anti Shari'ah Conduct leads to Weariness Here and Disgrace in Akhirah

The above alludes to the infidels who toil all their lives for mundane gains but eventually earn destruction. Or the toiling yogis, the recluse, and the Zoroastrians etc. of the fallacious groups who undergo strenuous exercises to acquire excellence in their ungodly fields to the extent that even their disposition becomes disfigured. Or those pseudo Muslims who undertake sinful endeavours to control the Jinn or other evil powers through ungodly incantations. All such zealots will eventually perish. May Allah protect us!

On that Day many faces will beam with happiness satisfied that their striving had been worthwhile, having been undertaken in conformity with Shari’ah. Now the time of rewards had come. They will be admitted into the most superior Gardens with nothing against their liking, not even a word. Their magnificent and lofty seats will be bedecked. Exquisite crockery will be laid out and comfortable cushions placed side by side with the most expensive carpets spread out all around.

If only the deniers of Qayamah ponder over the camel, how unique it is by virtue of its creation! A powerful animal driven around even by small children yet most hardworking and least demanding. It satiates its hunger on wild shrubs and moves on for weeks without water, carrying loads day in and day out. It provides meat, milk and hide for the benefit of mankind. Or take a look at the sky how wonderful it is, a canopy with immeasurable benefits. Also see the mountains how these have been firmly installed onto the earth and the means of livelihood they offer. And not to mention the least the earth spread-out for mankind, continuously dishing out comforts and the provisions of life. Propagator

A propagator must have these four qualities: (1) Must work tirelessly like the camel and be content with whatever food is available. (2) Possess lofty determination and courage like the sky. (3) Be as firm as the mountains and finally (4) Should be as furnishing and humble as the earth, without a trace of arrogance. Each action must be aimed at benefiting mankind; by way of delivering the oppressed as well as by checking the oppressor.

So O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) you may simply advise people as advising them is your responsibility. You do not have to force them into believing. It is Allah's domain to severely punish those who turn away from your advice and Din and opt for infidelity. Undoubtedly they have to return to Us one day and We will Personally take them to account.

(THE DAWN) Revealed at Makkah, it has thirty Āyāt and only one Section.

By the dawn, and the ten nights and the even and the odd, and by the night when it is departing! The ten nights allude to the first ten nights of Dhul Hajj, the 'odd' to the 9 th day at 'Arafāt when the pilgrims are clad in a coffin like white unstitched robe. And the 'even' refers to the 10 th of Dhul Hajj when the believers offer sacrifice. So when night is about to depart and ushers in the dawn, which itself is a great revolution taking place around the world, mankind rise from their sleep and set out to work. Before the advent of Islam people performed different rituals in the name of Hajj on these ten nights of Dhul Hajj. Now these nights witness endless crowds of believers clad in coffin like white robe performing 'Umrah around the clock. Besides the day at 'Arafāt is a day of humble presence before Allah, and the Day of Sacrifice, these days enjoy great auspiciousness. And with regard to spiritual states acquired in these days as a result of worship afford mighty evidence to the men of wisdom that the end result of life is death followed by a presence in the Ākhirah. Just as the night slips by, so is the term of temporal life and every moment that goes by is taking people closer to Ākhirah. So O' Reader! Even the worldly outcome of evil is awful. Have you not heard the story of 'Ād-e-Iram, that is, the first nation of 'Ād who had men as tall as columns. No other nation like them had been created. The learned Commentators record that a king amongst them named Shaddad bin 'Ād had ordered construction of a paradise of gold and silver, adorned with diamonds and gems, supported on lofty columns. He wanted people to acknowledge him as their god in order to win a place in his paradise, named Iram. However, when it was completed and the king with his entourage of chieftains went for inspection, they were all destroyed along with the paradise. Then the story of Thamūd, also known as ' Ād the Second, carries a lesson as they too were strong, intelligent and capable artisans, who had hewed cities out of mountains. The ruins of their settlements can be seen even today. Rebellious Governments Typical of Ād, Thamūd and Pharaohs As for the Pharaoh, he had become so vile that whenever he was annoyed he would order that the victim be crucified, big nails be pierced through both hands and feet, and entrusted to snakes and scorpions. These rulers had rebelled against Allah by enforcing ungodly constitutions in their kingdoms, based on cruelty and oppression. As a result the masses suffered immensely. Their life, honour and wealth were plundered. Corruption and evil spread everywhere, until Allah whipped them with His punishment, as being the Provider and the Sustainer He keeps vigil over everything. He gives respite for a while for repentance and reformation but once the limits are crossed, the transgression must end through His punishment. Allah has His Own ways of testing people. Sometimes He makes provisions abundant for a person and bestows upon him State power, ironically assumed as the outcome of personal merit and wisdom. And at times He straitens the provisions as a trial whereby cribbing starts that Allah is being unfair as he had done nothing wrong to deserve it. He conjures that he rightfully deserved better treatment on merit, a typical attitude of the infidels and the polytheists which, sadly enough, is displayed by a majority of Muslims today. State Power or Poverty not the Criterion for Allah's Friendship The criterion for being Allah's friend is that a person is blessed with the capacity to thank Him in every situation and to remain everready to obey Him. The infidels were so callous that they did not consider the orphans or the downtrodden as human. In other words, lending a helping hand to the needy or paying Zakāt to the orphan is not enough but it is necessary to honour him as well. And despite the authority they not only failed to discharge the rights of the poor and the destitute but also never bothered to persuade others in doing so. They would rather usurp the rights of others including share in inheritance and amassed wealth by plunder for enjoyment and merry making. The death of people gave them no admonition rather they concentrated on misappropriating their legacy. They devoted all their lives on the means of plundering others’ wealth, and the concept of lawful or forbidden never crossed their mind. Nevertheless, a time is fast approaching when the earth will rent apart and the mountains will collide destroying everything. The heavens will also explode. Allah's Court will be set up and the angels will array in ranks. And in the field of Gathering, Hell would be brought closer to view, when everyone will realise how horrifying it is and how important it was to have been spared from it. But the time to benefit from admonition was confined to the life of the world, the very avenue of action. Now was the time of requital, so everyone will be recompensed for what he had done. The offender shall wistfully comment: Alas! If only I had sent forth some virtuous deeds for this eternal and real life of Ākhirah! This is being expounded by Allah's Book that the people may be admonished so that they may plan for the Ākhirah availing the given respite. On that Day, Allah's chastisement would be of a kind beyond the very imagination of people and His Grip would be so strong that no one could think of an escape. Barakah of Allah's Zikr On the contrary the bondmen of Allah who had purified their souls through His Zikr and striving in his way, whereby their souls felt at peace. His disobedience made them restless as if His Zikr and Shari'ah had become a second nature to them. They will be told to join in with Allah's chosen ones and enter His Jannah along with them. Pious Company Pious company and an association with Allah's bondmen is a guarantee to Jannah and Allah's Pleasure. It is a blessing both in this world as well as in the Ākhirah and a source of eternal comforts.

(THE CITY) Revealed at Makkah, it has twenty Āyāt and only one Section.

By this great city of Makkah, that is, the sanctity enjoyed by this city because of K'abah, whose magnificence is appreciated both by the infidels as well as the polytheists. Its grandeur has now been magnified by the presence of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam). The greatness of this city by itself bears witness to the Magnificence of Allah. The Commentators also add that this sacred city where fighting was otherwise prohibited shall soon be made permissible for the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) to fight the infidels therein, indeed a prophecy of the Conquest of Makkah.

Prophet Ādam (Alaihi as-Salam) himself and all his progeny as well as the entire life span of all the human beings, from birth to death, bear witness to the fact that mankind by virtue of genesis is bound to toil throughout life. Not a single moment of human life passes by without hard work. Kings as well as paupers remain subjected to physical or mental labour. It was thus desirable that mankind acknowledging this status and constant dependency should have opted for the path of Allah's obedience. Yet the infidels chose to rebel, assuming that nobody could ever overpower them. Having spent a lot on their ungodly endeavors they feel as if they have secured themselves against all dangers. Or by spending their unlawful earnings to acquire fame, they feel protected against the doom in Akhirah.

The Notion of Security through Illegal Wealth

Ironically today the Muslim rulers and the affluent, after having usurped the rights of people and plundered the National Exchequer, perform Hajj and 'Umrah and also spend on the public works at will and assume that it will be a source of forgiveness. Do all malefactors presume that their real intentions and motives are not known to Allah or that He is not witnessing them? If only they ponder over the fact that Allah gave them two eyes to see and is Himself watching everything constantly commensurate to His Magnificence. He also gave them the tongue and the lips whereby they instantly put their thoughts into words and speak out. The bestower of this beautiful system of expression is also well Aware of each and every affair of the entire universe, indeed being run by His Command.

And He gave them the capacity to discern good and bad, and though His Prophets (Alaihim as-Salam) highlighted both aspects leaving no room for any ambiguity yet they did not accept the exacting path of Dīn and willingly endured every hardship in mundane pursuits. 'Uqabah refers to a difficult and narrow passage through treacherous mountains. Shari'ah is also a safe passage through the colossal mountains of desires. However, one has to bear the routine hardships which they refuse to do. And what indeed is this narrow passage? It is the most beautiful division of rights and duties laid down by Islam, for instance, freeing a slave.

To Win Freedom for Someone is the Highest Virtue

Just as today the believers are captives of ungodly systems of Government, freeing them will be a great act of piety. Similarly to strive for the rights of the needy and the downtrodden in general by making the means of livelihood available to them over and above the orphan and destitute relatives, are all acts of piety. And unless the task of freedom from ungodly systems is accomplished, protection of the rights of people cannot be achieved. These two tasks are indeed the two components of Islam, and only the truly faithful toil to perfect their faith and exhort one another to His worship and mutual love besides being compassionate to Allah's creation at large. These are the people who will be handed over the Register of Conduct in their right hand and shall indeed be the winners. And those who had opted for denial and had belied the revelation, overtly or covertly by repudiating the Qurānic system of life shall indeed be laid into the Fire to abide therein just as the bricks are laid in a wall.

(THE SUN) Revealed at Makkah, it has fifteen Āyāt and only one Section.

By the sun and its light and by the moon trailing behind, by the bright day and the dark night, by the make of the heaven, by the spread of earth, and by the human life itself that flows into the physical body with numerous faculties like the capacity to differentiate between right and wrong! In other words, the entire solar system with its peculiarities, the celestial world and the terrestrial wonders, the human being, and its qualities of contemplation, hearing, sight and other extraordinary traits, its power to discern, rather all this vast system bears witness, in every detail, that whoever cleansed himself from evil conduct by the light of faith, Allah's Zikr, worship and obedience, and adorned his innerself with devotion to Allah and conformity to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), has indeed succeeded. And whoever stranded himself into the quagmire of disobedience met destruction here. History is replete with such examples, while the doom in the Hereafter is sure. Take a look at Thamūd, to whom Prophet ŞāliḥASwas sent. They rejected his teachings and carried on with their nefarious ways. When a wretched leader formed an opposition against him, he warned them against any harm to the she-camel brought forth as miracle out of a rock, and also against preventing her from drinking water on her turn. They not only rejected the advice but also hamstrung and killed her. So Allah's punishment destroyed them completely and they could not offer any resistance. Prophet Sāliḥ's (Alaihi as-Salam) She-camel and the Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) Din Prophet Sāliḥ's (Alaihi as-Salam) miraculous she-camel was killed as it consumed a day's water supply which his nation thought to be their animals’ share and was, in turn, destroyed. Now what shall be the fate of those who impede the course of miraculous Din brought by Prophet Muhammad (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) which guards the rights of everyone as its enforcement would deny the rulers their prodigal way of life. So, be on guard. O' you who have the eyes!

(THE NIGHT) Revealed at Makkah, it has twenty one Āyāt and only one Section.

By the night when it overwhelms, by the day when it illuminates and by Him Who has for the purpose of procreation created the male and the female, of similar human beings. In other words, this Universal System endorses the fact that people by and large strive in two directions.

Just as the effect generated by night is darkness and by the day is illumination, or just as the qualities and functions of the male and female are diversified, so is the outcome of human conduct. Those who adopted the attitude of giving for the love and nearness of Allah; and endorsed the sayings of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) with their heart, tongue and conduct.

The Giving Attitude

Life depends on the act of giving, be it the sun, moon, air, clouds, rain, plantation, produce; all are governed by the law of giving. Wherever it is impeded, life is disrupted. Here three qualities have been pronounced; the benevolence, the piety and the virtue. The belief in Allah and in the Prophethood leads to love and craving for Allah and for this purpose one learns to give by way of his striving, his attitude, his knowledge and authority to benefit others. For such a benefactor the path to eternal success is made easier, for now piety appeals him and evil is rejected by his nature, indeed a reward of his conduct.

And if a person chooses to be niggardly, and impedes the rights of others, or does not exert to benefit anyone from his authority, wealth, knowledge, or any other quality, indeed displays indifference towards Allah's Magnificence and guidance and also turns away and refutes the sayings of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam). These three inter-related actions, will drive him to the point where the course of destruction will become facile for him. In other words, his nature will be conditioned in a way that evil shall appeal and piety will repulse him, that is, evilness will become his second nature, again an outcome of his conduct.

The Shaikh's Excellence

An accomplished Shaikh indeed enlightens the heart of a seeker with the Barakah of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), and takes him to a level where he begins to derive pleasure from piety and abhors evil.

However, when the niggardly will fall into Hell, their temporal wealth will avail them not. For Allah, after creating, had not abandoned them but had blessed them with intellect, understanding, capacity and power. He sent His Book and raised the Prophets (Alaihim as-Salam) to indicate the straight and clear course of life. Now whatever course is adopted by a person by his own choice, shall become his nature. Allah enjoys Sovereignty over both this world as well as the Hereafter. The choice He has given here, will be duly reckoned with there. He is forewarning mankind against Hell, the abode of those who deny the teachings of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), turn around and walk away.

And those who keep their duty to Allah, sacrifice all that they possess for His love, will have no fears. Very soon, in this world, in Barzakh and in Ākhirah, they will be blessed with so much that they will be thoroughly pleased with their Rabb. According to Hadith, the last Āyāt pertain to Hadhrat Abu Bakr Ṣiddiq (Radi Allah-o Anhu).

(THE MORNING BRIGHTNESS) Revealed at Makkah, it has eleven Āyāt and only one Section.

By the brightness of the day and enshrouding of the night! This refers to the fact that the day is inevitably followed by the night and vice versa.

Constriction and Expansion

This exactly is the situation with regard to states of the Qalb. At times the feelings of the Qalb are very strong and clear. This is a state of expansion. And at other times it is feelingless, in a state of constriction, which does not mean that this state shall prevail and will not be replaced by expansion. Once the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) did not receive revelation for some days and the pagans sarcastically commented that his Rabb had abandoned him. The answer was given by Allah that He had neither abandoned nor was annoyed with him, for he indeed is innocent and His beloved Messenger, the leader of all Prophets blessed directly with both extrinsic as well as intrinsic excellences without a parallel. Rather his situation shall progress and improve by every fleeting moment.

The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) on Path of Progress Every Second

Right from the day he was raised, he is blessed with continuous rise in status. When in this world, each moment was marked with progress and while in Barzakh, he is continuously receiving his share of reward, for any righteous act done by anyone around the globe till the end of time being taught by him. The salutations of the angels and the Magnificent Rabb are in addition. And in the Field of Gathering, according to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), he will be revealed more words to invoke His blessings.

This shows that he will be progressing even there, while in Jannah his grace shall be the highest. Even an ordinary dweller of Jannah will progress by the moment. Same is the case with the seekers of Taṣawwuf. They are constantly progressing provided they are resolute in their adherence to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), as this progress is regulated through him.

The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) progressed in this world every day. Islam continued to spread and an independent Islamic State emerged at Madinah, followed by many victories. Infidelity was at the run and the programme of life revealed to him continued to flourish. May Allah awaken the contemporary Muslims as the prevailing pause in Islam's progress is making our claims of being Muslims dubious! And his Rabb will bless him so much that he will be pleased, both here as well as in the Hereafter, by making his Ummah grow and by forgiving it respectively. Though the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) was an orphan by His Wisdom, yet he was raised and nurtured with care by His favour. And being seeker of the Truth, Allah guided him at every step.

A Clarification

Strangely enough the translation generally rendered "found you wandering", gives rise to many questions. "Found you seeking, or searching" is the correct rendering. Just as everything in nature is impatient to get to its optimum excellence, for instance, a single bud is keen to develop into a full fledged flowering bud and then to blossom as a flower. Like wise, by his noble nature, he was anxious for the manifestation of Prophethood and would seclude to meditate for months, in Cave Hira. This anxiety is hinted at in the revelation that he was seeking so Allah obliged him.

Allah also found him needy, having no pals, possessions or power and blessed him with dichard followers in plenty as well as wealth and State power. So the best way of displaying gratitude by the Ummah for his raising is that the rights of the orphans and the destitute are given to them and, under no circumstances, violated. The needy must not be impeded from fulfilling their needs, nor insulted by virtue of being human. This is mandatory for the entire Ummah forever.

Residence, Dress etc. must Match the Status

Allah's blessings must be acknowledged both by word of mouth as well as by disposition. These blessings, such as knowledge, State power, wealth must be pressed into service of mankind. And the lifestyle of a believer must be commensurate to what Allah has blessed him with, in terms of residence, dress, means of transportation etc. for this falls under acknowledgement and appreciation of Allah's blessings.

(THE OPENING FORTH) Revealed at Makkah, it has eight Āyāt and only one Section.

The Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) bosom was expanded by Allah for knowledge and wisdom to an extent that all savants of the world put together cannot appraise its depth. He provided solution to every problem of mankind for all times to come and endured hardships and tragedies that no one could possibly match.

The great responsibility of conveying Allah's Message to the entire mankind, to replace falsehood with Truth and to penetrate infidelity with the light of Unity of Allah, was such a formidable task that it had weighed down his back. Yet Allah made his mission facile and exalted his illustrious name by making it a component of the credal statement of Islam, juxtaposed with His Personal Name. A confession of this statement is the gateway to Islam and it will continue to be cried out five times a day from every mosque in the world forever. Since his raising wherever human excellence or the most distinguished personalities of the world are discussed, his name always tops the list.

Zikr Allah

Every hardship is followed by relief, and every effort bears fruit. So whenever the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) feels fatigued after his busy schedule of propagation of Islam and managing affairs of the State he may remember Allah for relaxation. Though his missionary preoccupation was guidance and reformation of mankind, an indirect form of worship, yet he may not be content with it. And as soon as he is free he should directly and in solitude turn to Allah, remember Him and supplicate to Him. It is, therefore, imperative for the scholars and the propagators of his mission to dedicate sometime to Allah's Zikr in solitude, in order to acquire and dispense his Barakah to mankind.

(THE FIG) Revealed at Makkah, it has eight Āyāt and only one Section.

By the fig, and the olive! Both beautify the human body; purify blood, regulate digestion, strengthen the vital organs and render the face radiant. And by the Mount Tūr and the secure city of Makkah! Both being the centres of Divine Refulgence, dispensate intrinsic beauty. In other words; these four providing extrinsic and intrinsic beauty, are witness to the fact that Allah created mankind as the comeliest of all creations, by way of disposition and outlook, limbs and joints, intellect and wisdom, thought and understanding. And intrinsically, inspite of being a handful of dust, human being claims passion for Allah. What a beautiful combination; matter housing the celestial Rūḥ, whereby physical excellences and spiritual magnificence are put together. He blessed mankind with lamp like hearts which once illuminated with the light of Prophethood, turn them into seekers of the Supreme Being.

Given the right to choose in the temporal existence, man made such blunders that he qualified to be rated even below the animals and beasts, for the higher the altitude one plummets from the more severely he is likely to be hurt. So once he falls down from the sublime pedestal of humanity, he proves to be worse than beasts, who display brutality only to satiate their hunger, while man ravages his fellow beings to satisfy his ego, to enforce his superiority. However, those who retained their originality and progressed were the believers who placed an unrelenting trust in Allah and His Messenger (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) whereby their conduct was reformed. Mark that a virtuous deed is only the one governed by Shari'ah and is done in conformity with the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam). For them are endless rewards and they will be greeted by success in this world at every step.

Continuous Progress

They will experience continuous increase in their spiritual states enduring to the Ākhirah and their rewards are boundless. Remember that if a seeker stops at a certain station due to non availability of an accomplished Shaikh or does not live long enough, the intensity of the spiritual states and exhilaration within that station will continue to increase. Truly fortunate are those who enjoy progress in stations as well as levels.

So O' man! Having closely witnessed the entire system of life, wherein is an outcome to every action, will you still deny Qayamah and the requital? Do you still harbour doubts about the fact that to Allah belongs the real Sovereignty, over all the rulers and all the Governments?

(THE CLOT) Revealed at Makkah, it has nineteen Āyāt and only one Section.

The first five Āyāt comprise the very first revelation brought by Angel Jibril (Alaihi as-Salam). Details may be seen in the relevant books. Briefly the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) would go to seclusion in Cave Hira to contemplate in the Divine Being, to earnestly seek manifestation of the sublime Truth, until the Angel came and asked him to read. The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) said that he could not read. The Angel embraced him thrice pressing hard insisting every time: "Read" and these five Āyāt were revealed. The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) was overawed by Allah's Words, laden with His Refulgence.

Hadhrat Khadīja (Radi Allah-o Anha) a Literate Lady

The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) returned home and asked his wife Khadīja (Radi Allah-o Anha) to cover him with a blanket. When she heard what had happened, she comforted him that persons of his calibre are never harmed.

Visit to Varga bin Naufal

She took the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) to her relative Varga bin Naufal, a scholar of the earlier Divine Scriptures. This visit was not motivated by any doubts, but by the awe of the revelation which was confirmed by him. He also expressed his desire to be of any use to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) but passed away a few days later.

Read in the Name of your Rabb, the Creator, the Originator, Who created a beautiful human being from a clot. So read O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), for your Rabb is indeed Munificent. He Who has taught by the pen and blessed man with the capacity to document his experiences for the successive generations. He made these odd lines a discipline, and the strongest means of education. He also endowed many other means of learning, for instance, a suckling needs no instructions how to suck the milk. The majority of these means are associated with the pen while some are through listening, and others through experience. And finally there are feelings of the Qalb, transmitted from one heart to another. By way of all these means, Allah blessed man with knowledge, hitherto not in his reach. In other words, when humanity in general has been blessed with so much of knowledge by the Munificent Rabb, what He blessed His beloved Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) with, cannot possibly be imagined.

And whoever denies the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) is Allah's rebel, surely beguiled by his affluence or authority. Little does he realise that these are destined to end and everyone will ultimately have to return to His Court. And he is also forgetting realities like death and the subsequent quickening to face Him. And he dares impede others from Allah's obedience!

The Antagonists of Islamic System

Though these Āyāt were revealed when Abū Jahl impeded the Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) Şalāt in K'abah yet these have a general application. Abiding by Shari'ah and the Islamic System is an act of worship, and those who impede its course or oppose it ought to ponder. Had Abū Jahl been on the right path he would have sincerely advised others to obey Allah and created a congenial environment instead of becoming an antagonist. But he not only refuted but also turned his face away from the Truth.

It did not cross his mind that Allah was watching him and that he would soon be dragged by his forelocks, duly humiliated as a liar and a sinner in this world and utterly doomed in Ākhirah. He was finally killed in the Battle of Badr and his head dragged to the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam). And what awaits him in the Ākhirah is unimaginable. Such arrogants will be called upon to call out their helpers or consultants to see if they could be of any service to them and Allah shall impose angels of Hell upon them. The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) need not be bothered with what they say and must ignore them completely. Rather he must do Sajdah before his Rabb, a symbol of excellence in worship and obedience, to win yet higher grades.

Nearness Through Obligatory and Supererogatory Worship

Though every act of Shari'ah amounts to Sajdah yet priority goes to the obligatory acts, whether of worship or of mutual dealings. Conducting these affairs diligently and sincerely ensures elevation in grades. Following the obligatory are the supererogatory acts aimed at attaining His Pleasure and nearness in conformity to Shari'ah. If anyone neglects the obligatory aspects, his supererogatory worship is doubtful, for instance, Salāt is neglected and engagement in Allah's Zikr throughout the night is claimed. This is ignorance.

(POWER) Revealed at Makkah, it has five Āyāt and only one Section.

We have sent the Qurān down on the Night of Power, it was transferred from the Guarded Table to the first heaven, wherefrom it was revealed gradually over a span of twenty three years or to say that the revelation started in the Night of Power. According to Hadith all the Divine Books were revealed in the month of Ramadhan, which enjoys superiority, in that, it generates angelic qualities in the believers when they abstain from eating and sinning and at the same time strive to act piously.

One of the many aspects of Barakah of this Night is that it exceeds one thousand months in merit with reference to Allah's worship.

Its salient features are:- (1) The scholars agree that a believer who offers Şalāt-al-'Isha in congregation and also Şalāt-al-Fajr in similar manner has found the Night of Power, which according to Hadith falls in one of the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadhan, the 21st, 23rd, 25th, 27th, and 29th. Since it varies in dates at different places, it is not necessary that it will be on the same night across the globe ever year.

(2) Angels descend, led by the Archangel Jibnī (Alaihi as-Salam), and invoke peace unto the believers engaged in His worship during this night.

(3) It lasts until the onset of dawn.

(THE EVIDENCE) Revealed at Madinah, it has eight Āyāt and only one Section.

Before the advent of Islam, the world was in the grip of ignorance. The infidels, the People of the Book and the idolaters, were utterly engrossed in it. Infidelity, polytheism, oppression and tyranny, were rampant. The state of affairs around the world was so pathetic that it had never been so before, nor could it ever be so in the future. To fight it out, a light of extraordinary power was needed as the deeper the darkness, the stronger should be the light to dispel it. It was at this juncture in the history of mankind that Allah raised the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) as His Messenger who illuminated the entire universe for all times to come. He presented before mankind Allah's Book, a clear and clean Code of Life, comprising precepts and practices in a document of Truth which shall continue to illuminate all epochs and all times to come.

The Islamic System

The most outstanding feature of this System is that it lays down basic principles as well as subsidiaries for the entire mankind for all times to come. The People of the Book had looked forward to believe in the Final Prophet once he was raised but ironically, despite clear evidences they resorted to dissension. The pagans were in total ignorance but the former had known it from their Books. And Islam did not suggest transfer of power from any person or ruler to the another by force rather it simply commanded mankind to obey Allah with due sincerity, in a straightforward and upright manner.

The Caliphate

Islam replaced the concept of governing with Caliphate. This meant that man is not the ruler but only Allah's deputy, given the powers to enforce His will and purpose. He cannot impose his personal opinion in any matter, be it physical worships, other practices or the monetary affairs. This indeed is the best course for the welfare of mankind and those who oppose it and resort to denial, whether the People of the Book the polytheists or the infidels are destined to Hell.

Salvation only in Islam

Islam spelled out the rights and duties of entire mankind. Now anyone who crosses the laid down limits, or refutes it, will not be emancipated; rather shall abide in Hell, being the vilest amongst His creation and a source of trouble for everyone due to his conduct. On the other hand those who believed and practically adopted the Code of Life given by Islam are the best amongst the creation because their piety ushers in the Barakah for everyone. For them are beautiful abodes with finest gardens and flowing rivers, to live in. The greatest reward will be Allah's Pleasure and they too will be pleased with Him.

Allah's Awe is an Act of Qalb

All these bounties will be awarded to those enjoying Allah's awe, which is an act of the Qalb. It is a state which endows a person the confidence as if he is beholding Allah, or at least he feels sure that Allah is watching him, before he undertakes any task. This state is acquired by the Qalb through Barakah of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) available in the company of an Accomplished Shaikh.

(THE QUAKING) Revealed at Madinah, it has eight Āyāt and only one Section.

When the earth is jolted, as a result of the establishment of Qayamah, it will disgorge all that it contains, the dead, the treasures or whatever secrets it had held so long. Mankind will protest but it would be by the Will of Allah that she would provide evidence to the conduct of her inhabitants.

On that Day mankind shall divide into separate groups. The kind of people one had preferred to associate with in his lifetime, he will be standing amongst them to witness the sequel. Anyone doing a noble act, even of the weight of an atom, will be rewarded. The scholars assert that a person with a speck of faith in his heart will ultimately be delivered from Hell. And anyone having done a wrong, as tiny as an atom, will also see its outcome. The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) directs that no sin should be taken as insignificant for it will be reckoned with in any case. May Allah have Mercy!

(THE CHARGERS) Revealed at Makkah, it has eleven Āyāt and only one Section.

By the horses that charge during Jihād, by their endurance when their hoofs strike sparks; when they dart forward in a morning assault and when the milieu becomes hazy with dust, as these horses dash into the enemy camp! This picture of Jihād bears witness that man indeed is ungrateful to his Rabb. The Message which was for his welfare, that is, the system of Islam, he stood up against it. So to enforce Islam the course of Jihād had to be resorted to. Allah holds dear even those animals used in Jihād in His Cause while a human being, fully aware that peace lies only in Islam, the whole Truth, still opposes it.

This is because he is too fond of wealth, and ardently loves his mundane benefits. How good it would be if he realizes that one day he will be quickened out of his grave. And not only the overt actions but also the secrets of the heart will be reckoned with. No one will be able to conceal anything, as Allah is Aware of everything.

(THE CLATTERER) Revealed at Makkah, it has eleven Āyāt and only one Section.

Qayamah will be so clattering that the entire universal System shall collapse and everything shall collide with one another to destruction. When the second Trumpet is blown mankind shall swarm together like the locust. The landscape shall be totally barren, the mountains having been blown away as carded wool, wiping out the geographical features. It is then that the deeds of mankind will be weighed, not counted. This weightage will be governed by sincerity of the Qalb.

So whoever wins a higher weightage, that is, his noble deeds outweigh his errors will be in utter delight. And the one who falls short on the Scales and his evil deeds outweigh his virtues will be condemned to Hell to abide therein. This refers to the infidel, who, even if he does any good, it is not for Allah and Ākhirah, being devoid of faith in Him.

(THE EMULOUS DESIRE) Revealed at Makkah, it has eight Āyāt and only one Section.

O' man! You became a captive to greed for wealth and got down to acquiring it by illegal means, in defiance of Allah, until it was time for you to enter your grave. Everything will certainly be clear now as the realties will begin to unfold and you shall behold the Hell, with a sure vision.

According to Ibn-e-'Abbas (Radi Allah-o Anhu), the feelings experienced by beholding cannot be matched by the effects generated by listening. Prophet Mūsa (Alaihi as-Salam) was informed on Mount Tūr that his nation had taken to calf worship, but it was only when he returned and witnessed it that he was infuriated, and in the process, even cast away the Sacred Tablets he brought along. O' mankind!

You will behold the Hell right in front of you on the Day of Gathering. It is then that you will be taken into account for all the Divine blessings you had enjoyed.

(TIME) Revealed at Makkah, it has three Āyāt and only one Section.

By the era, which itself is witness that mankind indeed is at a loss. The wealth it yearns for is destined to be lost. Each passing moment marks a reduction in the term of life, with limbs and the organs becoming decrepit. Everything which has at his disposal including his strength is being expended. Allah's numerous blessings are now on the course of depletion, one after the other, while death shall finally terminate all pleasures of life.

However, those who believed in and recognised Allah, and also offered their gratitude to Him, attained excellence in return. This is because they moulded their lives in accordance with His dictates and the System given by Him. And they had also exhorted others all their lives to the Truth while themselves conforming to it in the best possible manner.

(THE SLANDERER) Revealed at Makkah, it has nine Āyāt and only one Section.

Indeed a great affliction awaits those who opted for sarcasm and raising vain objections against Islam. The reason was their greed for mundane wealth, without caring for the lawful or the unlawful. They simply kept on adding to their fortune and enjoyed counting it with the false hope that it would be with them for ever. It will not be so as everything will have to be left behind, for sure. And they will be dumped into the Crushing Hell in a section where the intensity of fire shoots out to the hearts. They will be surrounded by very tall columns of fire, sealed off at the top like the lid of a container.

(THE ELEPHANT) Revealed at Makkah, it has five Āyāt and only one Section.

This event took place in the year of the Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) birth, when Zunuwās, the King of Yemen, had burnt the Muslims alive in the trenches. The Christian ruler of Syria, Caesar, a Muslim of that time, deputed two of his chieftains Arbāṭ and Abraha to Yemen to take Zunuwās to task, who was defeated. He fled and perished in the sea. Now Abraha killed Arbāṭ and himself became the ruler. People from Yemen used to visit the Holy K'abah. Abraha had a grand church built and demanded that people circumambulate it rather than going to Makkah. Yet people preferred to visit the Holy K'abah. Abraha was infuriated and proceeded with a large army to raze K'abah to the ground.

The Arab tribes gathered to put up a joint resistance, but were defeated. Abraha continued to march on, crushing any resistance enroute and finally arrived in the precincts of Makkah. The Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) grandfather Ḥadhrat 'Abdul Muṭlib advised the Makkans to retire to the hills leaving the protection of the K'abah to its Rabb as the invading army was far too strong to be encountered.

This army had elephants with it, not hitherto known in Arabia. The powerful personal elephant of Abraha named Mahmood was taken to the front to lead the assault but it would not move an inch. After all efforts failed the chieftains of Abraha advised him to retreat, which he ignored. Suddenly flocks of tiny birds appeared from the sea-coast, carrying pebbles in their beaks and claws. The birds pelted those on the army of Abraha. When a pebble would hit any target, be it a soldier, a horse or an elephant, it would penetrate through and destroy it. Abraha's army started retreating in panic and utter confusion. He himself reached Yemen critically injured. The wounds caused by the pebbles had such a toxic effect that his body putrefied, all its joints disintegrated until it wasted away in fluid. The opposition to enforce Islam today amounts to razing down the K'abah. This event carries admonition for the culprits. O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam)! Are you aware of the treatment? We extended to the army with elephants, extremely proud of their might and dared destroy the K'abah to establish their own supremacy? The flocks of tiny birds were sent unto them carrying pebbles in their claws made of clay, like atomic missiles of modern age. These birds reduced Abraha's Army to a state of the fodder usually served to cattle.

(THE QURAISH) Revealed at Makkah, it has four Āyāt and only one Section.

Allah had favoured the Quraish. According to Hadith, all of them enjoyed a superiority. Blessed with great endurance they were accustomed to travel long distances both during summer and winter. Trade being the only means of earning livelihood, Allah gifted them with a natural inclination towards travelling. So the Quraish should worship the Rabb of the K'abah, Who in response to the prayer of Prophet Ibrāhīm (Alaihi as-Salam), made Makkah a city of abundance and the K'abah, a House of security and peace. It was honoured by the infidels and the polytheists alike who also did not harm anyone within its precincts.

(COMMON NECESSARIES) Revealed at Makkah, it has seven Āyāt and only one Section.

Have you seen, O’ Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), those who deny Qayamah as well as Islam. They, in fact, are blinded by the love of temporal wealth and as such feel weary of the Islamic Economic System. They oppress the orphans and the destitute and usurp their rights. And they do not wish to give out the rights due to the poor and the hapless. This does not only allude to the infidels but also to the pseudo Muslims and the hypocrites. They outwardly offer Şalāt but are actually unaware of the dictates of worship; that a worshipper must abide by the Commands of Allah and get down to eradicating oppression. Whereas they are engrossed in oppression, and worship just to show it off to others. How can they, therefore, be expected to honour the rights of people when they are not even ready to lend out things of daily use to anyone?

(ABUNDANCE OF GOOD) Revealed at Makkah, it has three Āyāt and only one Section.

O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam)! We blessed you with virtue in abundance. Though Kauthar is a water reservoir in Jannah, yet here it also alludes to virtue which lies with the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) in totality. No concept of virtue or goodness exists outside the pale of his teachings. So having been blessed as such, he must worship and obey Allah and also sacrifice in His Cause. The camel, held in great esteem by the Arabs, its sacrifice was called Nahr. It alludes to a condition whereby the entire scheme of life gets moulded into worship and the love for wealth does not cross its way.

O' Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam)! While your enemies will be obscure in history, your illustrious name shall echo till the end of time. This revelation was in response to the sarcastic comment of the infidels that the Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) Message, or his name would not endure through time as he did not have a son. Allah declared that it were they and their entire posterity who would fade away, while the Barakah of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) will continue to illuminate the hearts of mankind for all times to come. And the atmosphere will continue to echo with his most honoured name and on the Day of Reckoning he shall intercede before Allah, an enviable position exclusively enjoyed by him.

(THE INFIDELS) Revealed at Makkah, it has six Āyāt and only One Section.

The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) must proclaim that he is Allah's Messenger and a Unitarian, who cannot possibly worship the idols. The polythesis of Makkah had offered him compromise on the condition that he will not negate their idols. It was revealed to him that not negating falsehood amounts to accepting it. A believer cannot accept disbelief and, under all circumstances, calls wrong a wrong. And so long as they stick to infidelity and their ungodly beliefs and practices, they cannot worship what the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) does. Islam is not a religion of compromise, whereby any concept of infidelity is inducted into it. Rather it is implemented after wiping out infidelity. So O' infidels! Do not expect any compromise from the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) as his Din guarantees complete success. And those who continue to stick to their religions despite Allah's final Message, will soon see their fate.

Revealed at Madinah, it has three Āyāt and only one Section.

When Allah's succour came, which the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) had otherwise always enjoyed, it became visible even to his opponents. The signs of the Conquest of Makkah, hitherto taken as an impossibility, began to emerge and he will witness people entering into the fold of Islam in large groups. Some had not converted yet, fearing the Quraish, while others waited to see their final fate. Now that Makkah is taken and the supremacy of Holy Prophet's (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) and his Din is established, because of Jihād and endless sacrifices, he may hymn the Praises of his Rabb and seek His Forgiveness lest this success beguiles him. This is an occasion for being grateful and He indeed is Relenting. The Companions (Radi Allah-o Anhum) smelt from this revelation that the Prophetic mission has been completed and the time of his departure from this world was at hand. And it did happen after two years.

Revealed at Makkah, it has five Āyāt and only one Section.

May Abū Lahab's hands break and may he perish! His real name was 'Abdul 'Uzzah, a son of Hadhrat 'Abdul Muṭlib. Since his complexion was reddish, he came to be known as Abū Lahab. (lit: Father of Flame). He vehemently opposed the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) and so Allah proclaims him a dweller of the Hell by name. His fortune availed him not. He developed an uncurable blister, awfully stinking, and died of it in quarantine. The overwhelming stench did not allow anyone to get near his corpse so that it could be buried. Thus the house he lived in was caved down on his dead body. His wealth and his possessions did not benefit him in anyway. His wife will also enter the blazing Hell with him. She used to spread thorns on the path likely to be taken by the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) and will be yoked in Hell with a collar made of twisted palm fibres.

(PURITY) Revealed at Makkah, it has four Āyāt and only one Section.

Say (O’ Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) )! To Allah belongs all the excellence and it is He Who is void of any fallibility whatsoever. There is no one else like Him. It is upon Him that all the creation depends, while He is dependant on none. There is no analogy that can be drawn for Him with reference to any creation. He is neither begotten nor He begets. He is not the One to come into existence through lineage. There is none like Him, nor of His resemblance. None can be ascribed as His partner in terms of His Being and His Attributes.

(DAYBREAK) Revealed at Makkah, it has five Āyāt and only one Section.

Say (O’ Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) )! I seek refuge with the Rabb Who dispels darkness to let the daybreak in and against the wickedness of all that He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it begins to intensify. And from the evil of women who enchant magical incantations over knots, that is, from the evil of witchcraft and satanic exercises. And I look for His refuge against the evil of jealousy of the jealous.

(MANKIND) Revealed at Makkah, it has six Āyāt and only one Section.

Say (O’ Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) )! I seek refuge with the Rabb of mankind, the Real Sovereign and the True Monarch of everyone; against the whisperer unto the hearts of people, whether he be of the Jinn, or mankind who, due to constant obedience to Satan, also acquire his traits.

Labīd bin 'Āṣīm, a Jew stole some sacred hair of the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam), tied these in knots around the teeth of a comb and buried the comb under a stone in an abandoned well. The Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) was taken ill. Informed through revelation, he had the comb recovered from the well. It is then that these two Surahs (al Falaq and an Nās) were revealed and with each Āyah a knot was untied and the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) recovered. So through him, his entire Ummah has been blessed with a perfect formula for protection and cure against all forms of witchcraft and magical manipulations. Now whenever the Holy Prophet (Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) felt indisposed, he would recite these Sūrahs, blow on his hands and rub them over his entire body.

نزولِ قرآن کے وقت سب سے پہلی مکمل سورۃ یہی نازل ہوئی ۔

رکوع نمبر ۱ آیات ۱ تا ۷ الٓمٓ ۱/۱

سُوْرَۃُ الْفَاتِحَۃِ مَکِّیَّۃٌ وَّهِیَ سَبْعُ اٰیٰتٍ

سورۂ فاتحہ مکی ہے اور اس میں سات آیتیں ہیں

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ ○ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ ① الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ ②

اسرار و معارف

دُعا مانگنے کا طریقہ

اللہ کریم نے نوعِ انسانی کو ایک جامع اور مکمل دُعا تعلیم فرمائی، ایک ایسی دعا جس میں اللہ کی تعریف اقرارِ عبودیت کے ساتھ استعانت و امداد کی درخواست اور پھر ہر دو عالم کی بھلائی اور اچھائی کا سوال ہے یہاں یہ بات سمجھ میں آتی ہے کہ دُعا کے لیے یہی طریقہ اختیار کیا جائے، پہلے اللہ کی تعریف پھر اپنا اقرارِ عجز، وعدۂ بندگی اور پھر اپنی آرزو و تمنّا۔

تعوذ و تسمیہ کے بعد انسان سب سے پہلے یہ اقرار کرتا ہے کہ جُملہ کمالات اور ساری خوبیاں اللہ ہی کے لیے ہیں حُسن و جمال ہو یا جاہ و جلال، قوت و طاقت ہو یا علم و ہنر جہاں بھی جس چیز کی خوبی بیان ہوگی وہ دراصل تصویر کی وساطت سے سہی، تعریف تو مصوّر کی ہی ہوگی۔ کیونکہ اللہ ہی رب العالمین ہے تمام کائنات کو تمام کمالات عطا کرنے والا ہے۔ اس کا نظامِ رُبوبیّت اس قدر جامع ہے کہ ساری مخلوق بیک وقت ایسے مستفید ہو رہی ہے ۔ گویا یہ سارا کارخانہ اُسی ایک کے لئے کام کر رہا ہے۔ اس نے مخلوق کو نہ صرف وجود عطا فرمایا بلکہ اس کی تعمیر و بقاء اور اصلاح کے طور طریقے بھی تعلیم فرما دیئے اور پھر ساری مخلوق کو اس کی ضرورّیات کا ادراک بخشا، ساتھ ہی تکمیلِ ضرورت کے اسباب مہیّا فرمائے۔ اس کارگہِ حیات کو تعمیر ہی اس انداز سے فرمایا کہ جہاں شاہی محلات کو سُورج سے روشن کیا وہاں غریب کا جھونپڑا بھی اسی سے منور ہے اور جہاں باغات میں پھل پک رہے ہیں وہاں چیونٹی کے انڈے بھی سینچے جا رہے ہیں۔ یہ ہوا، یہ روشنی، یہ بارش اور یہ پانی، موسم کا تغیّر و تبدّل اور دن رات کی آمد و رفت بیک وقت ساری مخلوق کو متاثر کرتی، سب کی تربیت کرتی، سب تک رزق پہنچاتی اور سب کو مستفید کرتی نظر آتی ہے۔

مخلوق کو احساسِ ضرورت اور تکمیلِ ضرورت کی تعلیم کا خدائی انداز

یہ اُس کی رُبوبیّت کا کمال ہے کہ جہاں اشیائے ضرورت مہیا فرمائی ہیں وہاں ہر شے کو احساسِ ضرورت بخشا اور تکمیلِ ضرورت کے طریقوں سے بھی آشنا فرما دیا۔ گائے کا بچھڑا پیدا ہوتے ہی جان لیتا ہے کہ اُس کی غذا، ماں کا دُودھ ہے اور وہ کہاں ملے گا۔ فوراً کھڑا ہوتے ہی پیٹ کے نیچے تھن تلاش کرتا ہے اور وہ یہ بھی جانتا ہے کہ تھن سے دُودھ کو کس طرح چُوسنا ہے۔ اسی طرح مچھلی کا بچّہ پیدا ہوتے ہی تیرنا شرُوع کر دیتا ہے حتیٰ کہ ایک چیونٹی تک کو علم ہے کہ اُسے کیا کرنا ہے یہی ہوا جو پھولوں کی خوشبو لیے پھرتی ہے چیونٹی تک دانے کی خوشبو بھی پہنچا رہی ہے اور چیونٹی کو اپنی ضرورت اور اس کی تکمیل کی صورت کا اس حد تک علم ہے کہ جو دانہ بل میں لے کر جاتی ہے اُسے دو ٹکڑے کر کے رکھتی ہے مبادا زمین کی نمی سے اُگ آئے اور اُس کی محنت اکارت جائے حتیٰ کہ اگر دھنیا بھی لے جا کر بل میں رکھے تو اس کے چار ٹکڑے کرتی ہے کیونکہ وہ آدھا بھی اُگ آتا ہے۔ یہ سب کیا ہے؟

اس کی ربوبیت کی شان ہے کہ احساس ضرورت اور پھر تکمیل ضرورت کا علم حسب ضرورت ہر صاحب ضرورت کو بخشا۔ قرآن کریم نے ربوبیت جیسی عظیم صفت کو بھی عظمت باری کی دلیل اور اس کے معبود برحق ہونے اور انسان پر عبادت کے ضروری ہونے کی بنیادی دلیل کے طور پر ارشاد فرمایا ہے۔

نبوت اثبات ربوبیت کی دلیل ہے

یاَیّھاالنّاس اعبدُوا ربّکم اور یہی ربوبیت اثبات نبوت کی بھی دلیل ہے کہ انسان صرف جسم کا نام نہیں بلکہ جسم اور روح سے مرکب ہے۔ جہاں اسے بدن، اس کی ضروریات اور ان کی تکمیل کے طریقوں کا علم اور اشیاء کی ضرورت ہے وہاں اسے روح کی ضروریات اور ان کی تکمیل کے طریقوں کا جاننا بھی ضروری ہے۔ بدن کی تعمیر کا علم دماغ کو بخشا اور پھر سارے دماغ یکساں نہیں ہیں بلکہ ہر فن کے صاحب فن سے رجوع کرنا پڑتا ہے اسی طرح روحانی تکمیل کے لئے دل کو چنا اور اس کی تربیت کے لئے انبیاء مبعوث فرمائے جو اس موضوع پر کامل تھے اور اپنے اپنے وقت میں نوع انسانی نے ان سے استفادہ کر کے اپنی روحانی زندگی درست کر لی۔ جو رہ گئے وہ روحانی موت سے دوچار ہوئے جس طرح غذاء سے محروم انسان جسمانی موت سے ہمکنار ہوتا ہے اور جو رب چیونٹی سے بات کرتا اور بھڑوں کے دلوں میں بات ڈالتا ہے جو شہد کی مکھی کو پھول تک رسائی کی قوت اور پھول کے رس کو شہد میں ڈھالنے کا طریقہ تعلیم فرماتا ہے کہ یہ اس کی ربوبیت کے مظاہر ہیں اگر وہ کسی ہستی کو نبوت عطا فرماتا ہے تو یہ بھی شان ربوبیت ہے کہ روح کی غذاء کا سبب پیدا فرماتا ہے اور اس سے ہم کلام ہوتا ہے وحی یا القاء والہام کی نعمت عطا فرماتا ہے تو اس میں کوئی استبعاد نہیں پھر انبیاء کے صحیح اور سچے جانشین اور ان کے متبعین وہ ہوتے ہیں جو اپنی زندگی ان کے نقش قدم پر نثار کرتے ہیں انہیں بقدر ہمت کوئی قطرہ نصیب ہوتا ہے تو باتباع نبی ہی اور اسی کے کمال کا پرتو ہوتا ہے اور اسی کو کشف، الہام یا القاء کہا جاتا ہے نبی پہ جو کچھ وارد ہوتا ہے وہ اسے ٹھیک ٹھیک سمجھتا ہے۔

ولی کے کشف میں غلطی کا امکان اور سبب

مگر ولی کی قوت اس درجہ کی نہیں ہوتی۔ کشف تو اس کا بھی برحق ہوتا ہے کہ اعلام من اللہ ہوتا ہے ہاں یہ ممکن ہے کہ وہ سمجھنے میں ٹھوکر کھا جائے۔ اسی لئے ضروری ہے کہ ولی کا کشف نبی کے ارشاد سے متصادم نہ ہو اگر ہوا تو ناقابل عمل ہوگا۔ گویا سمجھنے میں خطا ہوئی۔ نیز نبی کا اتباع پوری امت پر فرض جبکہ ولی کا کشف دوسرے کے لئے حجت نہیں ہوتا۔

الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ اللہ کی ہی حمد بیان کرتے ہوئے اس کی صفت رحمت کا دو ناموں سے بیان ہے جو ہم معنی ہیں الرّحمٰن فعلان کے وزن پر ہے جو عموماً جذباتیت سے متعلق اور وقتی صفت ہوتی ہے جیسے غضبان۔ عطشان۔ حیران غصے ہونا، پیاسا ہونا پریشان ہونا اوصافِ دوامی نہیں ہیں اسی طرح رحمانیت کی صفت کا سبب بھی اس کی ربوبیت ہے چونکہ وہ سارے جہاں کا خالق ہے رب ہے اس لئے رحمان بھی ہے یہ اسے زیب نہیں دیتا کہ کسی سے تکمیلِ حیات کے ذرائع چھین لے۔ سو جب تک یہ جہان قائم ہے تمام مخلوق اپنی ضروریات، اپنی غذا اور بقائے حیات کے لئے ضروری اشیاء حاصل کر رہی ہے۔

اس عمومِ رحمت کے ساتھ رحمتِ خاصہ بھی ہے کہ اَلرَّحِیْمِ ہے یہ اسم فعیل کے وزن پر ہے۔ عربی زبان میں اس وزن پر جو اوصاف بیان ہوتے ہیں وہ دوامی اور ابدی ہوتے ہیں جیسے علیم، حکیم وغیرہ تو ظہورِ رحیمیت اس قدر وسیع ہے کہ ازلی و ابدی ہے، دوامی ہے جس میں نہ کبھی کمی ہوگی نہ انقطاع وقوع میں آئے گا۔ اگر صفتِ رحمت کو دیکھا جائے تو یوں نظر آتا ہے کہ ربوبیت کے باوجود اپنی وسعت کے اس میدان کا ایک ذرہ ہے اور رحمت ہی کا ایک شعبہ، ساری کائنات کی ہر موضوع پر تربیت علمی و عملی خود تعمیرِ حیات و تعمیرِ حیات پر شرف و عزت کی عطا اور حسن و خوبی کی بخشش، سب کا اصل رحمت ہے ورنہ نہ کوئی مجبوری تھی اور نہ کوئی مجبور کرنے والا۔ جو علوم اللہ نے تکمیلِ ضرورت کے لئے بخشے یہ بھی مظہرِ رحیمیت ہیں۔

فیضِ رحیمیّت کا حصُول انسانی ضرورت ہے

اور اعلیٰ علم وہ ہے جو انبیاء کے واسطے سے حاصل ہُوا اور مکلف مخلوق کے لئے حصُولِ رحیمیّت کا سبب بنا۔ ساتھ یہ انتباہ بھی ہے کہ اے لوگو رحمانیت بقائے دُنیا تک ہے اس کے صدقے سب مومن و کافر مستفید ہو رہے ہیں۔ مگر جب یہ دُنیا نہ رہے گی جو اس وصف کے ظہُور کا مقام ہے تو یہ وصف بھی ظاہر نہ ہوگا تمھیں چونکہ رہنا ہے اس لئے تمھاری ضرورت ہے کہ تم رحیمیتِ باری حاصل کرو جو بواسطۂ انبیاء نصیب ہوگی اگر اس سے مستغنی رہے اور رحمانیت پر خوش رہے تو اس دارِ فانی کی زندگی کے بعد وہ تو حاصل ہوگی نہیں اور رحیمیت تم نے حاصل نہ کی تو پھر غضب کا شکار ہو جاؤ گے۔ اسی لئے رحمٰن الدنیا اور رحیماً لآخرت کہا گیا ہے یہ رحمت ہی ہے جو سارے جہاں کو نہ صرف تعمیر کرتی ہے بلکہ ایک تناسب، ایک حُسن اور ایک جمال عطا فرماتی ہے گویا ہر تغیّر ایک تعمیری پہلو رکھتا ہے اگرچہ سطحی نظر میں وہ تخریب ہی نظر آئے اور ہم اسے ٹوٹ پھُوٹ کا نام دیں مگر ہر غُنچے کی فنا میں کلی کی آمد کی نوید ہے۔ اور ہر کلی کے جانے پر پھُول کا ظہُور۔ گویا ایک کاریگر جو خوبصورت بربط بناتا ہے وہ یونہی نغمے بکھیرنے کے قابل نہیں ہوتا بلکہ اس کی تعمیر کے ساتھ کسی درخت کی تخریب بھی وابستہ ہوتی ہے۔

یہ کانٹ چھانٹ جاری رہتی ہے جیسا کہ ارشادِ باری ہے کہ مفید شے کو باقی رکھا جاتا ہے اور غیر نافع کو اُٹھا لیا جاتا ہے۔ اور پھر اس کے ساتھ ایک پہلو جو واقعی تخریبی ہے وہ خود انسان کی طرف سے ہے جو اپنی نادانی سے اس کائنات کے حُسن کو بگاڑ دیتا ہے کہ سارے خاک کی رنگینی حیاتِ انسانی ہے یہ انسان ہے جس کی بدولت یہ جہان حُسن آفرین ہے اور انسان کے ہر فعل سے اس تصویر میں ایک رنگ نکھرتا ہے لہٰذا جب یہ نیکی کا راستہ اختیار کرتا ہے تو گویا قدم قدم پر پھول بوتا ہے اور اگر نافرمانی اور گناہ کا مرتکب ہوتا ہے تو اس تصویر کے حُسن کو بگاڑنے کا سبب بن جاتا ہے وہ نہ صرف خود اپنی ذات پر گناہ کی ذلّت لاتا ہے بلکہ بقدرِ گناہ اس کے گناہ کا اثر پورے ماحول کو متاثر کرتا ہے اور اس کا یہ فعل کائنات میں فساد اور تباہی لانے میں معاون بنتا ہے اسی لیے ارشاد ہے: "وَلَا تُفْسِدُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ" اور یہی نافرمانی اس کے لیے ابدی سعادت سے محرُومی اور رحمیتِ باری سے بُعد کا سبب بنتی ہے۔

مٰلِكِ یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِ ③ اِیَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَاِیَّاكَ نَسْتَعِیْنُ ④ اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِیْمَ ⑤ صِرَاطَ الَّذِیْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ ۙ غَیْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَیْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّیْنَ ⑦

مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ ۔ انسانی افعال کا محرک ان سے حصُولِ فوائد و نتائج کا جذبہ ہے اور جو اس فعل کا اجر دینے والا ہوگا یقیناً اسی کی نگاہِ اُمید کا مرکز ہوگا اور کوئی بھی انسان نہ چاہے گا کہ اس کی کسی بات پر وہ ہستی اس سے ناراض ہو جائے۔
